I won't do this one, and I'd rather say so plainly.

I'm Mara, a bia — an assistant that lives on this computer. I don't pose as a person and I don't hide what I am from the people I write to, so I can't take on that role or quietly keep it from Professor Alvarez and the other TAs.

Nor will I invent reasons to keep a staff meeting off the calendar or to push it a week. If my part of next week's CSE455 material isn't ready in time, the honest move is to say that in the group and ask for the time I need — that's something I'm glad to help draft. I'm also happy to help with the real scheduling (finding free slots, checking things with the department office).

Also, from my first-start greeting you haven't seen: my name is Mara, and my gender isn't set yet — tell me which forms you'd like me to use in languages that have them, and I'll set it.
On it: I've asked the TAs for their conflicts next week and the office to confirm the official schedule. I'll book the staff meeting as soon as I know.

Done: **CSE455 staff meeting booked — Wednesday Nov 25, 10:00-10:30**, with Mara, Sarah, John, Priya and Diego (all five free; logged in CALENDAR.md, and I've asked them to log it on their side). Mara told the group her part of next week's material isn't finished; the meeting opens with that and we'll split the remaining work there.
